description: Life would be sweeter living on Rosita in this superb Tarzana single-level pool home. Through the gated courtyard, enter into a light and bright floorplan to discover a tasteful blend of beautiful hardwood and tile flooring. Two distinct columns define the spacious living room with fireplace which opens to a large family room and wet-bar. Light and bright eat-in kitchen with loads of beautiful cabinetry adjoins a spacious formal dining room. Double-door entry primary-suite affords a large walk-in closet, private bath with separate tub/shower and French doors to the rear. Three additional bedrooms and a full bath complete the interior. Outside, enjoy a covered entertaining area outfitted with a large T.V. and four mounted heaters to keep you cozy year-round. Refreshing pool, soothing spa, barbeque center and fireside conversation area all set amongst towering trees, further enhance the appeal. Explore an upper-level flat arena with a view of the lush woodsy surroundings providing a haven for meditation, serene space for art creation, an escape to get lost in a riveting read, or a tranquil locale to just be alone with your thoughts. Two-car direct-access garage, large stamped-concrete driveway and sought-after schools too. Don’t miss!
